findings.claim: Alpha Omega is classified as EXACT_TARGET for the cardiovascular-death/MI/stroke composite even though its endpoint includes cardiac interventions. The broader endpoint is disclosed elsewhere, but the exact-match classification remains incorrect.
NCT06720662 is labelled completed, whereas the supplied AACT snapshot records it as NOT_YET_RECRUITING. Its listed completion date does not establish actual completion.

numeric_checks.note: Manual recomputation from the six supplied log-HRs and CI-derived SEs gives Paule-Mandel tau² approximately 0.012915, pooled log-HR approximately -0.06336, and HKSJ SE approximately 0.06090. Using t(5)=2.57058 reproduces the served rounding. No commands were run.
